authority_rule: Historical active stage contracts and LOCKED checkpoints win until explicit versioned migration + independently verified gates; this matrix does NOT override the active prompt.

conflicts.problem: Existing Stage3A/3B/3C checkpoints must not be treated as one already-completed Stage3 record.
conflicts.resolution: Use one Stage3 enrichment dossier with a crosswalk to the unchanged 3A identity/evidence, 3B production, 3C dispositions.

conflicts.problem: Shifting full instructional enrichment to Stage3 cannot remove independent Stage4 linguistic/adversarial review.
conflicts.resolution: Stage4 becomes final risk-targeted independent challenge of whole Stage3 source-hash-bound output; 100% mechanical scope + independently reviewed semantic risk queue.

conflicts.problem: Kombinationen needs cross-field comparison against examples/senses/related terms; per-field reviews miss learner-visible duplicates.
conflicts.resolution: Stage3 joint-card enrichment ledger with teaching_delta and same-card comparison; zero combos CLOSED_NO_FORCE valid.

conflicts.problem: Source-backed and curated pedagogical data must not be conflated, fabricated, or silently written into immutable source.
conflicts.resolution: Every learning unit cites source locator or CURATED_PEDAGOGICAL with lineage; editable target hashed, source immutable.

conflicts.problem: Backend family types and one learner-visible Kombinationen section differ; collapsing backend types loses provenance.
conflicts.resolution: Keep backend typed combinations and fixed presentation name Kombinationen, no UI changes.

conflicts.problem: Stage3/4 proposal must not imply Stage5 projection or CURRENT Stage6/Stage7 success.
conflicts.resolution: Separate Stage5 deterministic projection, Stage6 exact runtime acceptance, Stage7 final release and user acceptance.

conflicts.problem: Older Stage4 reviewer identity rule may conflict with user-approved 2026-10-25 independent AI method policy.
conflicts.resolution: Do not demand external human signature; require documented AI-linguistic independent-method second pass and adversarial audit, never falsely label human.

conflicts.problem: Some streams are LOCKED/final, some Stage4 WIP; a global stage swap would invalidate historical state.
conflicts.resolution: Opt-in per-workstream next-safe-boundary pilot; frozen baselines untouched; use successors for LOCKED, CAS on editable bytes.

conflicts.problem: Editorial reports without applied source bytes and full QA cannot count as enrichment completion.
conflicts.resolution: Require input/content/output SHA256, item totals, unresolved HOLD count, exact applied mutation receipt, and stage-specific status.

conflicts.problem: Legacy L24 Stage3C and Stage4 JSON statuses and workstream-specific checkpoint keys vary.
conflicts.resolution: Introduce adapter-only crosswalk; do not change old schemas; validate known samples and preserve unknown fields.

conflicts.problem: Per-review ZIP uploads and ambiguous Project-linked backups grow storage; cleanup must not erase recoverability.
conflicts.resolution: One editable working authority; no micro ZIPs; retained exact recovery pins; Library dedupe strictly verified bytes and dependencies.

conflicts.problem: Lexical rules do not automatically apply to Grammar/Lesen/Schreiben units unless emitting standalone lexical cards.
conflicts.resolution: Define per-content-class applicability profile; non-lexical content remains under its workstream QA.

rollout.target: new lexical content successor only, no runtime or active prompt mutations
promotion_requires: recoverable backup of exact editable source
